name: GREENTEC
recent: Greentronics 以 RM2,000,000 现金收购 Tujuan RE 51% 股权，后者将成为间接持股 51% 的子公司。公司最新季度（2026-06-30）营收同比下滑 64.5%，并录得净亏损。此外，执行主席在闭市期前申报了交易意向。
notable: 以 RM2,000,000 现金收购 Tujuan RE Sdn Bhd 51% 股权。
执行主席 Dato' Goh Soo Wee 申报在闭市期前进行交易。
risks: 最新季度净亏损 MYR 113,000，营收同比下滑 64.5%。
执行主席在闭市期前申报交易意向，可能涉及股权变动。
earnings: 2026-06-30 季度营收为 MYR 5,416,000，同比下降 64.5%，环比下降 10.6%；净亏损 MYR 113,000，净利率 -2.1%，而上一季度净利率为 3.0%。

recent_en: Greentronics is acquiring a 51% stake in Tujuan RE for RM2,000,000 cash, making it an indirect 51%-owned subsidiary. The latest quarter (2026-06-30) saw revenue fall 64.5% year-on-year and a net loss. The Executive Chairman also declared an intention to deal during the closed period.
notable_en: Acquired a 51% equity interest in Tujuan RE Sdn Bhd for RM2,000,000 cash.
Executive Chairman Dato' Goh Soo Wee declared intention to deal during the closed period.
risks_en: Latest quarter recorded a net loss of MYR 113,000 with revenue down 64.5% year-on-year.
Executive Chairman declared intention to deal during the closed period, which may involve a change in shareholding.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 5,416,000, down 64.5% year-on-year and 10.6% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was MYR 113,000 with a net margin of -2.1%, versus a net margin of 3.0% in the prior quarter.
